name: jump puts the caret at the end of the scene
ArrowRight at scene end moves to the next scene start
ArrowLeft at scene start moves to the previous scene end
ArrowDown on the last line moves into the next scene
ArrowUp on the first line moves into the previous scene
typing after crossing lands in the scene that has the caret
Backspace at scene start joins the first paragraph onto the previous scene
one undo reverts a cross-scene join in both scenes (expected to fail: history is per scene)
native drag selection stays inside the scene it started in (browser clamps at the editing host)
mouse drag from one scene into the next makes a cross-scene selection
copy of a cross-scene selection returns the model text
cross-scene selection is drawn in both scenes
typing over a cross-scene selection deletes it through the model and inserts the character
Shift+ArrowRight past the scene end extends the selection into the next scene
Shift+ArrowDown keeps extending inside the next scene; copy matches the model
Shift+ArrowUp back into the first scene returns to a native selection
select-all then copy returns the whole project from the model
find counts every match in the model, mounted or not
find jumps to a match in a scene that was not mounted
browser find-in-page reaches the whole project (expected to fail: only mounted text is in the DOM)
the scene holding the selection stays mounted after scrolling 60,000 px away
typing while the caret scene is off screen still edits that scene
a scene with an active composition is not unmounted (not testable here: no IME control in WebKit automation)
variant 2: text typed after a jump lands at the caret (selection repair off)
variant 2: text typed after a jump lands at the caret (selection repair on)
